topics.title: Rate limiter: twenty orders a minute
topics.summary: Counts each visitor's order requests per minute in Redis and refuses the twenty-first.
topics.why: The limit is a check that runs before the order is saved, so the order of calls shows it best.

topics.title: Orders use real prices
topics.summary: The orders service asks the pricing module for each item's price and refuses an empty order.
topics.why: The price changes shape as it moves from the request to the saved order.

topics.title: Orders data model
topics.summary: Where an order, its items and their prices are stored.

topics.title: Order events on the queue
topics.summary: A new event tells other services an order was placed.

topics.title: Old throttle removed
topics.summary: The unused in-memory throttle is deleted.
